basis: inventory.json plus change names; membership is provisional until each cluster's proposals, designs, specs, and tasks are read at cycle start
ordering_rationale: Consensus and replication integrity first (largest coupled surface), then scheduler completion, world/merge/replay, storage and publication, fault recovery, service-state assertions, runtime and component pilots, and finally pattern, protocol, observability, and evidence work

clusters.note: Raft-backed control-plane changes share membership, replica-status, and promotion-identity surfaces
Direct successors of the F09/F10 scheduler work already in acceptance; start only after those close

adopt-shared-wasm-component-runtime is prerequisite-gated on the hardened-wasmtime-runtime producer and Mantle consumer-verifier work; keep it behind the other members until those immutable publications exist

cycle_template: Read every member's proposal, design, specs, and tasks and confirm membership and ordering
Record the cycle-scoping entry in the attempt ledger with the frozen source binding
Implement members with focused tests and enabled/disabled/profiler feature coverage as their tasks require
Run each member's recorded acceptance checks and required gates, retaining raw command records
Sync and archive each member only after its own acceptance passes; record unfinished members with their blocking condition
limits: Draft only; membership and order may change when member artifacts are read
No acceptance criteria are weakened by clustering
Eight cycles is an estimate; rework cycles consume the same budget
